titleEnglish: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chhant:

verses.translation: Jaitsree, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chhant:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
verses.translation: God is lofty, unapproachable and infinite. He is indescribable - He cannot be described.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, who is all-powerful to save us. ||1||
